capabilities: Copy a note right next to the original
Save a snapshot of a note to a user-defined folder
Trigger both actions from the file context menu
extras: The README is minimal; it describes only two context-menu actions with no settings or options beyond the user-defined snapshot folder.
motivation: The author built it for the need to back up an important note before modifying it or to keep a history of changes made to it.
problem: Obsidian has no quick way to manually back up a note before modifying it or keep copies of its earlier state.
summary: Backup utility that creates a copy of a note next to the original or saves a snapshot to a user-defined folder via the context menu.
